slice: PAR-71 / 7O.3 DXF refusal for unrepresented DWG anonymous-block placement

researchBasis.rule: Autodesk's current common DIMENSION grammar assigns 41 to line-spacing factor, 42 to actual measurement, and 53 to text rotation; it does not document the DWG anonymous-picture scale/placement rotation as DIMENSION fields. INSERT codes are not interchangeable with DIMENSION fields.
researchBasis.boundary: Do not infer that no application-specific extension exists. Until an interoperable representation is demonstrated, reject nondefault placement instead of silently losing or mis-mapping it.

behavior: Shared dxfRW entity preflight rejects nonfinite anonymous-block scale/rotation and rejects any finite scale other than (1,1,1) or placement rotation other than zero before writing the DIMENSION record.
The diagnostic for finite nondefault placement is dimension-picture-placement-unrepresented.

The generated scratch control calls the direct dxfRW DIMENSION writer through the dx_iface callback, verifies failed fileExport preserves an existing destination, then retries through the same dx_iface; each fileExport creates a fresh dxfRW instance.

Controls cover default aligned DIMENSION, NaN scale rejection, nondefault XYZ scale on aligned DIMENSION, nonzero rotation on ARC_DIMENSION, and nondefault scale on large radial DIMENSION; each negative control asserts the direct writer call returns false.
change.fixturePolicy: All output files are generated under the temporary test directory and cleaned by RAII. No DWG/DXF fixture was added or committed.
change.registration: No CTest registration or dependency was added; the control is part of the existing libdxfrw_dwg_local_roundtrip test executable.

proves: Local DXF writer rejects the tested nondefault anonymous-block placement routes before emitting the DIMENSION record.
The direct dxfRW DIMENSION writer call returns false on each tested nondefault route.
The tested failed whole-file export leaves the pre-existing destination bytes unchanged.
A retry using the same dx_iface with default placement succeeds after each rejection.
doesNotProve: independent producer agreement on the DWG scale/rotation fields
a valid DXF group-code mapping or transform-baking implementation
native CAD acceptance, dimension rendering, editability, or association behavior
full DIMENSION interoperability or general DWG/DXF support
evidenceBoundary.commitReason: The shared worktree contains broad unrelated changes in the same source, test, and plan files; staging or committing whole files would include user work outside this slice.
